proposer_change.change: Write gross margin once in each section of ART-0019 while avoiding commercial words in all other documents.
proposer_change.why: Round 9 lowered train commercial_per_k from 2.257 to 2.090, and preserving gross margin in ART-0019 was intended to satisfy the bl-001-docx-5mb-image retrieval gate.

writer_notes: Train vector improved on top_opener_share (0.112 vs 0.130) and unique_sentences (58.167 vs 48.833) while lowering commercial_per_k to 2.090 with zero worsened dimensions.

However, bl-001-docx-5mb-image still failed its BM25 top-3 retrieval check because bl-001-docx is built from ART-0007 (the Incident RCA), not ART-0019, and removing margin from the PDF lowered the corpus document frequency of margin from 6 to 4 so the PPTX files (which contain margin in chart titles) outranked the DOCX on bl-001-docx-5mb-image.

Therefore, to keep BM25 IDF balanced across the 6-file corpus and ensure bl-001-docx-5mb_final.docx ranks in the top 3 for bl-001-docx-5mb-image, ART-0007/Standing exposure (in the DOCX) should mention gross margin forecast once, and PDF/PPTX prose should also mention gross margin once per document so margin appears in all 6 files (df=6, zeroing its BM25 IDF) while avoiding all other commercial words.
